description: Alignment maps and pLDDT profiles for CCT5, BBS6, BBS10, BBS12 against 3RUW
code:
exec(open("bbs10/helpers.py").read()); exec(open("bbs10/tmalign.py").read())
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SA=json.load(open("bbs10/structalign.json"))
tgt=parse_pdb(fetch_pdb("3RUW")); tidx,tseq,tres=chain_res(tgt,'A')
site=[38,39,40,41,59,60,61,91,92,93,94,95,156,157,159,160,161,386,403,404,440,444,473,475,476,488,490,495]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,8))
names=["CCT5","BBS6","BBS10","BBS12"]
for ax,q in zip(axes.ravel(),names):
    d=SA[q]; pl={int(k):v for k,v in d['plddt'].items()}
    qidx=d['qidx']
    xs=sorted(pl); ys=[pl[i] for i in xs]
    ax2=ax.twinx()
    ax2.plot(xs,ys,color="0.75",lw=0.9)
    ax2.set_ylim(0,100); ax2.set_ylabel("pLDDT",color="0.5")
    pairs=d['pairs']
    ax.plot([qidx[i] for i,j in pairs],[tidx[j] for i,j in pairs],'.',ms=2,color="#2b6cb0")
    for s in site:
        ax.axhline(s,color="#e53e3e",lw=0.4,alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_title(f"{q} vs 3RUW chain A, TM = {d['tm']:.2f}")
    ax.set_xlabel(f"{q} residue"); ax.set_ylabel("Mm-cpn (3RUW) residue")
    ax.set_ylim(0,530)
plt.suptitle("Structure-based alignment of AlphaFold models onto ADP-AlFx-bound group II chaperonin (3RUW).\nRed lines mark the 28 nucleotide-site residues; grey curve is pLDDT.")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
